description: NaLaNb(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.61 Å) and three longer (2.91 Å) Na-O bond lengths. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.27 Å) and three longer (2.33 Å) La-O bond lengths. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.04 Å) and three longer (2.08 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-38°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.62 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom.
